name: Permanent Residence Permit (Law No. 10 of 2018)

requirements.blocker_text: 20 years' continuous legal residence in Qatar, plus financial self-sufficiency, a clean criminal record (in and outside Qatar), and adequate Arabic proficiency.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 20 years of continuous legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: 10 years' continuous legal residence for a person born in Qatar, plus financial self-sufficiency, a clean criminal record, and adequate Arabic proficiency.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 10 years of continuous legal residence.

requirement_groups.name: Exempt categories (Article 2) -- bypass standard residence requirement

requirements.blocker_text: Falls into one of six exempt categories: child of a Qatari woman married to a non-Qatari; non-Qatari husband of a Qatari woman; non-Qatari wife of a Qatari man; child of a naturalized Qatari citizen; person rendering special national service; or holder of specialized skills/'exceptional competencies' Qatar needs.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 20 (or 10) years' continuous legal residence

sources.title: Gulf Labour Markets, Migration and Population (GLMM) Programme -- Qatar Law No. 10 of 2018 regarding Permanent Residence: Article 1 (20yr/10yr residence + self-sufficiency + clean record + Arabic proficiency), Article 2 (six exempt categories), annual quota of 100 permits/year, benefits (healthcare, education access, spouse/children under 18 covered, extendable to age 25 for university-enrolled sons)

DISTINCTIVE STRUCTURAL FEATURE, PROMINENTLY FLAGGED: an ANNUAL QUOTA OF ONLY 100 PERMANENT RESIDENCE PERMITS may be granted per year across ALL categories combined -- confirmed in the law's own text, not just secondary reporting. This makes PR, not just citizenship, a scarce, capped status in Qatar. application_window.cap_type is set to 'fixed_number' to reflect this quota; no numeric selection_odds could be computed since the applicant pool size isn't published. pr_after_months is 0 for this file's own outcome (it IS the PR grant) but is referenced as 240 by qa_work_permit.json's outcome as a rough alignment point, not as a formal prerequisite route -- Qatar's system does not require holding a specific prior route id for the standard track, only years of residence however accrued.
